Wells Fargo Co New (WFC) Holder Northpointe Capital Has Lowered Its Stake; As Wells Fargo & Co New (WFC) Stock Declined, Holder Hoertkorn Richard Charles Lowered Its Holding
May 20, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Northpointe Capital Llc decreased its stake in Wells Fargo Co New (WFC) by 51.04% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Northpointe Capital Llc sold 42,522 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.98% with the market. The institutional investor held 40,787 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.48M, down from 83,309 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Northpointe Capital Llc who had been investing in Wells Fargo Co New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $261.67B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.96% or $0.52 during the last trading session, reaching $53.7. About 21.49M shares traded or 6.75% up from the average. Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC) has declined 7.75% since May 20, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.30% the S&P500.
